# Operation support evidence

<!-- Generated by tools/support_matrix.py --write; edit support-ledger.json. -->

This initial inventory records 21 bounded profiles, not complete format parity. All roadmap IDs remain visible below. Statuses cite historical installed-wheel evidence; validation of this file is not a new test run or a completion decision.

Ledger source-audit baseline: `bfbaafc96cd533416d6af9fbbd052a4d2ada471e`. Historical tests do not certify this source revision. Native adapter/facade changes need their own behavioral review and release validation; matching fixture hashes are only a drift check.

Operations: **read** normalized content; **create** native-format serialization; **edit authored/imported** distinguish model provenance; **preserve** only named unchanged content; **render** PNG; **export** conversion to a named different format. Saving is not conversion.

Statuses: **verified** for the stated scope; **partial** with a stated gap; **unsupported** in the current facade; **blocked upstream** for a cited native constraint; **unassessed** without adequate evidence; **n/a** where the operation has no meaning.

The pinned SDK feature-family crosswalk remains in [API design](authoring-api-design.md). The [pinned reference-family inventory](reference-api-inventory.md) groups representative SDK/PyMuPDF members; complete member dispositions remain unfinished work. No public capability-query API is introduced.

Maintain `docs/support-ledger.json`; run `python tools/support_matrix.py` to check and `python tools/support_matrix.py --write` to regenerate. A changed test-file digest requires review of its assertions/fixture provenance and relevant artifact evidence, not a blind hash refresh. Native citations were source-audited at their immutable pins; the offline checker validates their references, not native code execution or remote symbol existence.

## pdf.region

PNG rendering of a page-view rectangle; not content-stream clipping.

**Public paths:** `open(...).render_page(..., clip=...)`, `open(...)[0].get_pixmap(..., clip=...)`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic small PDFs built in test_render_clipping.py with native authoring; explicit CropBox/Rotate/UserUnit dictionaries in the test exercise geometry. PNG samples are decoded by the local test helper, with narrow fixture-specific rounding tolerances. No third-party PDF corpus is implied.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **n/a** — This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion. |

| Edit authored | **n/a** — This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion. |
| Edit imported | **n/a** — This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion. |
| Preserve | **n/a** — This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion. |
| Render | **verified** — Display-space rectangles honor CropBox, rotations and UserUnit; finite/positive/intersection/resource checks. Tested tolerances are fixture-specific, not universal pixel identity. ## word.properties

Strict scalar custom properties, separate from core/extended metadata.

**Public paths:** `open(...).metadata["custom"]`, `new("docx").update_metadata(custom=...)`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic DOCX built by the public authoring API; test_imported_properties.py replaces the custom property ZIP part with explicit scalar, malformed, duplicate and oversized XML fixtures. Source patches are test-only, not a runtime parser/writer.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **partial** — lpwstr, bool, i8 and finite r8 only; 1024 entries / 64 KiB value / 256 KiB raw aggregate. ASCII-ambiguous names all omitted. ## pdf.owned-fields

Owned single-widget text/checkbox/choice fields with fixed appearances and bounded Unicode tooltip metadata and native read-only state; no radio/script/multiline profile.

**Public paths:** `new("pdf").pages[0].fields.add(...)`, `field.value`, `field.box`, `field.tooltip`, `field.read_only`, `pdf.fields.flatten()`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic PDFs authored in test_pdf_fields.py and test_field_geometry.py; the latter uses local PDF geometry fixtures with rotation/CropBox/UserUnit. Assertions inspect actual PNG pixels, metadata, owned copy independence and flattening results. Tooltip fixtures additionally author all three kinds on four rotated CropBox/UserUnit pages, assert owned metadata/copy/readback/clear/resize/value behavior and exact PNG/flatten-control equality. Saved AcroForms still reject editable reopening; native TU roundtrip has separate artifact-level Rust evidence, not an imported-field Python certification. Read-only fixtures cover the same three kinds/four rotated page views, exact render and flatten-control equality, native programmatic same/different/clear refusal with warm-cache rollback, copied/unset recovery, permitted box/tooltip/delete behavior and strict-bool/stale identity.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **partial** — Owned field handles expose bounded values/options, current-view geometry and Unicode tooltip metadata; absent/cleared tooltips read as empty strings. This is not imported AcroForm extraction. Owned handles also expose strict boolean read-only state, preserved across copied/page-organized owned models; saved editable AcroForm reopening remains rejected. ## pdf.geometric-comments

Native rectangle/ellipse outlines with fixed solid unfilled two-user-unit stroke and at least three-unit dimensions; existing comment opacity property also covers canonical notes and four markup kinds. Creation evidence remains rectangle/ellipse only; no page-content drawing or secure redaction certification.

**Public paths:** `page.annotations.add("rectangle" | "ellipse", ...)`, `annotation.box`, `annotation.color`, `annotation.update(...)`, `annotation.opacity`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic native shapes and minimal imported annotation fixtures; actual outline pixels, empty centers, saved PNG equality, rotations and CropBox/UserUnit. A separate direct-native tiny-oval regression motivates the conservative minimum. Opacity controls use seven native-authored kinds on white/colored backgrounds at 72/144 DPI, both writer representations and saved native readback. Hand-built fractional-CA imported acceptance is rectangle only.

|---|---|

## word.story-clear

Clear owned header/footer or note content; retain section references/variants or note references/kind/options. No linkage change, semantic note deletion or imported story adoption.

**Public paths:** `Section.header(...).clear()`, `Section.footer(...).clear()`, `Note.clear()`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic paragraph/table/image-first stories include nested tables, shared PNGs, page fields and outgoing bookmark links. Native section XML, ownership, copy isolation, decoded PNG colors and PDF page text are asserted; no arbitrary source stories are edited. New owned footnote/endnote fixtures verify blank canonical styles/one own mark, unchanged source IDs/options, long-note repagination and retained next counters, copies/no-ops/conversion, fields/outgoing links and actual colored number-mark PNG/PDF pixels. Native-only cleanup fixtures do not certify public rich note insertion.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **unassessed** — This mutation profile does not certify complete auxiliary-story extraction or an imported story inventory. |
| Create | **n/a** — Container creation is separate; clear reuses an existing owned header/footer or note. |
| Edit authored | **verified** — Existing stories clear atomically, invalidate their child handles and reclaim only unreferenced resources. Missing/repeated synthetic-empty clear is a true no-op preserving cached render and range revision; authored empty paragraphs are removed. Owned notes clear to a hidden canonical styled placeholder while retaining the external reference/kind. Original empty note paragraphs clear once; clear-convert-clear is a no-op and re-add uses a fresh child without an extra blank. ## pdf.object-stream-output

PDF full-writer object_streams=True/False representation policy on existing serialization/save; no incremental save, version downgrade, general compression or archival conformance.

**Public paths:** `PdfDocument.to_bytes(object_streams=True)`, `PdfDocument.save(destination, object_streams=False)`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic authored text, PNG, vector path, links, geometric annotation, outlines, metadata and fields plus conservative CropBox/Rotate/UserUnit imports. Test-only raw startxref inspection distinguishes modes; no public mode-inventory accessor is implied.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|

## pdf.native-search

Read-only bounded native PDF text rectangles from existing page handles, retaining native text order; rectangles are not normalized block offsets or guaranteed visible-ink regions.

**Public paths:** `Page.search_for(text)`, `PdfPage.search_for(text)`

**Fixture provenance:** Original small PDF byte fixtures define ToUnicode ligatures, ActualText, two columns, reversed text scales and invisible/clipped text; authored Unicode text uses the existing attributed font fixture. Tests inspect native rectangle coordinates/decoded pixels and owned-result/cache lifetimes, not OCR.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **verified** — Case-insensitive literal native matching with normalized whitespace, ligature/ActualText mapping and native column order; CropBox/rotation/UserUnit view boxes. Query limit 4,096 UTF-8 bytes and bounded post-interpretation glyph/match/rectangle work fail rather than truncate. Hidden/clipped text remains searchable; no regex, OCR, visible-only search or Office search. ## pdf.comment-locks

Strict boolean native editing lock for canonical notes, four text-markup kinds, rectangles and ellipses. Flag mutation only; no general annotation creation/style or security certification.

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic native-created seven-kind comments use the local rotated CropBox/UserUnit PDF fixture and exact pre/post PNG comparisons, saved reopen, copies and blocked mutation controls. Imported acceptance separately uses the existing minimal canonical rectangle fixture plus saved/reopened native seven-kind output. Malformed/unsupported imported rectangle variants assert unchanged bytes/warm cache. No new geometric creation or foreign appearance regeneration certification.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |

## slides.background-reset

Remove an explicit owned solid/PNG slide background override through Slide.background=None; the getter reports direct state, not resolved inherited color. No master/theme editor or generic imported-media preservation.

**Public paths:** `slide.background = None`, `slide.background`, `slide.background_image`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic public solid/PNG slide backgrounds with text/link shapes, shared picture/second-slide assets, independent copies and normalization callbacks. Assertions inspect absent p:bg, direct getter None, actual PNG/PDF output, retained text/links and final media reclamation. Native artifact tests separately inject master/layout color/gradient/picture controls, compare exact before/after PNG and exported-PDF PNG, and reject explicit-picture removal with direct inherited-picture assets before authored-only pruning.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |

| Read | **partial** — After reset the explicit background and explicit background_image getters return None; explicit picture override still makes the color getter unsupported. Native inherited-image/gradient getter controls belong to artifact-level tests, not arbitrary imported Python inventory. ## word.closed-shapes

owned direct-body unrotated Rectangle/Ellipse in horizontal sections. Dimensions1–4000pt in0.05pt increments; outline0.25–100pt and no wider than min(width,height); full outline must fit its physical page and inline width its column. Only native inline/square/top-bottom/behind placement with exact Page/Page, Margin/Margin or Column/Paragraph anchors. No imported editing, lines, textboxes, rotation/front/groups/effects or auxiliary/cell shapes. Existing non-top alignment and rendering resource limits remain.

**Public paths:** `WordDocument.add_shape`, `WordDocument.shapes`, `shape.kind`, `shape.size`, `shape.fill`, `shape.stroke`, `shape.format`, `shape.formatting`, `del word.shapes[index]`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic public authored rectangle/ellipse and native coupled-anchor/primitive fixtures. Exact source/handle/copy/deletion/callback controls, DOCX ZIP/native readback,2pt outline/fill native-versus-PDF full-page colors at72/144/300DPI, body links/table/note-story/image preservation, document shape_geometry_omitted diagnostic and native malformed/budget/locator tests. Separate116 native upgrade evidence supplies0.25/2/100pt corners/outlines and bounded min-dimension ratio cases; it must be cited as native evidence, not described as public full-range tests. No independent Microsoft Word acceptance or arbitrary imported-shape preservation.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **partial** — owned handles read supported properties; reopened semantic extraction omits shape geometry with its existing document diagnostic and does not fabricate image/text geometry. Native DOCX readback checks selected properties; this is not general shape extraction. ## pdf.typed-underlays

Built-in point/boxed text and PNG/JPEG underlays via behind=True on existing PdfPage.draw_text/add_image. Strict bool defaults False; native typed placement only. No supplied-font/raw-path underlay, added-item handles, replacement/removal or general layer manager. Existing resource collisions refuse atomically.

**Public paths:** `PdfPage.draw_text(..., behind=True)`, `PdfPage.add_image(..., behind=True)`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic owned and imported offset-CropBox/UserUnit PDFs with original opaque content, built-in text/links, PNG/JPEG bytes, copies and callback controls. Four page rotations are paired with four explicit image transform profiles; full page extents at72DPI and80pt image regions at72/144/300DPI. Owned160pt pages have full-page color/text controls at72/144/300DPI. Hidden and revealed content use separate owners; no background reset is introduced. Exact native typed models/source pixels and both save modes supplement visual tests. This is a finite matrix, not every parameter combination or pixel-perfect PDF composition.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **partial** — Reopened extraction retains tested original/added labels, link targets, decoded PNG source pixels and exact JPEG bytes, including hidden source text; extraction is independent of ink visibility. No underlay inspection or added-item handle API.
